slices.focus: Two back-to-back storm weeks produce the strongest evidence yet: the system holds, with faster notices, tracked emergency cargo, and quicker schedule recovery.
slices.summary: Two consecutive storm weeks test the system under sustained pressure. The posted schedule is restored within a day both times — a marked improvement over the baseline. Ayaka presents side-by-side charts to management comparing three measures: notice update speed, emergency pallet tracking, and passenger confusion complaints. The shift-owner clock is identified as the single most confusion-reducing element. Management's tone shifts from skepticism to note-taking. Ayaka prepares a tight formal request to adopt the core standards.
